content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The claim for CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification, yet the clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). The note further records a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), for which continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management. We therefore request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on medical necessity grounds for the outstanding balance of 718.50."}
